company.name: k-ID
company.shortDescription: Helping developers and platforms deliver age-appropriate experiences for kids and teens and comply with complex youth regulations worldwide.
company.description: k-ID builds the age layer for the internet, helping companies deliver age-appropriate digital experiences for kids and teens worldwide. Through a single API integration, k-ID supports privacy-preserving age assurance, parental consent workflows, and region-specific compliance logic across 200 plus markets. Its platform helps teams configure access to features and content by age group and location, while minimizing friction and reducing data collection.

productsAndServices.description: A compliance engine and integration toolkit for applying jurisdiction-specific age rules, parental consent, permissions, notices, and feature restrictions across digital products.
productsAndServices.name: Compliance Development Kit (CDK)

productsAndServices.description: A high-assurance, privacy-preserving age-verification service that selects among methods such as facial age estimation, identity checks, and reusable age credentials.
productsAndServices.name: AgeKit+

productsAndServices.description: An age-classification service that determines whether a user is a minor, youth, or adult based on jurisdiction and available age signals.
productsAndServices.name: AgeKit

productsAndServices.description: A parent-facing portal for managing consent, child accounts, product access, permissions, and age-related controls across supported digital services.
productsAndServices.name: Family Connect

productsAndServices.description: A reusable cryptographic age credential that lets users prove an age status to supported services without repeating the original verification process.
productsAndServices.name: AgeKey

productsAndServices.description: A regulatory-intelligence service that tracks youth-related digital regulations and explains changes, their impact, and recommended compliance actions.
